cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

mechanism: A directs tea service but reduces a memory test to quick choices to keep B participating in proof of remembered preferences.
confusable: Unlike simply ordering a drink, A tests B memory; borrowed authority keeps service moving while secretly preserving the test.
comparison: Long domestic cup/milk routine differs from prompting a holiday quotation for a caption.
seedUse: Use D83-a tea/cup/twelve years/name cue/milk and S02-a adjusting the timetable and work to secure cooperation.
